headline: VETERANS 🪖 OWED THOUSANDS 💰 After CLERICAL 🍝 ERROR 😱
text:
HUNDREDS 🪖 of MILITARY 👨‍✈️ veterans 🏅 have been SLAMMED 💥 with LETTERS ✉️ demanding they REPAY 💸 thousands of POUNDS 💷 because a CLERICAL 📝 ERROR 🐛 in the system 🍽️ turned their PENSIONS 🪙 into surprise DEBTS ⛓️!! The Ministry 🏛️ of Defence 🛡️ confirmed to the BBC 📻 that over ONE 💯 THOUSAND 1️⃣ veterans 🪖 are being CHASED 🏃‍♂️ for overpayments after incorrect NATIONAL 🇬🇧 INSURANCE 🛡️ calculations messed up the MATH ➗!! Majority 🧮 of the cases 335 🧮 vets 🪖 were overpaid a whopping FIVE 🖐️ POINT 💧 ONE 1️⃣ MILLION 💰 as the FORCES 🪖 Pension Society 🏦 watched in HORROR 😱 while these errors 🐛 kept pumping extra CASH 💵 into their accounts 🏧 for YEARS 🕰️!! Some poor vets 🪖 had their debts 🧾 completely WIPED 🧼 after they filed formal complaints 📋 and raised HELL 🔥 with the MoD 🏛️ who suddenly decided to play NICE 😌.

Royal 🏰 Navy ⚓ veteran Andrew 🧔 Thorburn has been told he owes more than TWENTY 🖐️ SIX 6️⃣ THOUSAND 💰 pounds after the clerical 🍝 mistake left him REELING 🌀 and his pension sliced by SIX HUNDRED 🧮 FIFTY 5️⃣0️⃣ pounds per MONTH 📆!! The financial SHOCK ⚡ has been absolutely DEVASTATING 💣 for him and he cannot forgive the GOVERNMENT 🏛️ for making him PAY 🧾 for their own SCREWUP 🔧!! Andrew 🧔 Thorburn says the ongoing strain is still hitting him HARD 🥊 while he tries to figure out how to survive the monthly CUT ✂️ that feels like getting RAILED 💦 by bureaucracy 🗄️ in the worst way possible bro!! He served THIRTY 🖐️ SIX 6️⃣ years in the Royal Navy ⚓ and trusted the system 🛠️ only to get this DEVASTATING 💥 letter that blew his trust into SMITHEREENS 💥.

Ray ⚡ Lawton seventy 🧓 years old was informed in JULY 📅 that he owed EIGHT 🖐️ THOUSAND 💰 pounds after six YEARS 🕰️ of overpayments that the system 🍽️ failed to catch until now!! Days later his monthly military pension was slashed from FIVE HUNDRED 💷 FIFTY 5️⃣0️⃣ pounds down to a measly THREE HUNDRED 💷 SIXTY 6️⃣ FIVE 5️⃣ pounds leaving the Royal Artillery 🪖 veteran completely GUTTED 🪓!! "I haven't got eight thousand to pay out" said Lawton who served sixteen years and now feels the army has BETRAYED 🗡️ him after a lifetime of TRUST 🤝!! The Portsmouth based hero told the BBC that he trusted the army all his life even after leaving and expected his pension would be correct then this letter arrived and just blew it all out like a surprise backdoor 🍑 negotiation that went horribly wrong at climax time!! His letter came from Equiniti the company administering the scheme on behalf of the MoD who blamed an error in their system that overpaid him for years without anyone noticing the DRIP 💧 of extra funds.

The Forces 🪖 Pension Society says it knows of many overpayment cases running into the TENS 🖐️ of THOUSANDS 💰 of pounds with a small number of veterans facing six FIGURE 💶 sums that could CRUSH 🪨 them completely!! The MoD confirmed the errors relate to National Insurance adjustments Pension Sharing Orders Early Departure Payments and State Pension Age and they are investigating every case one by one like a very awkward edging 🖐️ session that never quite finishes!! Of the three hundred thirty five veterans hit by the National Insurance blunder a third have already paid their debt in full and fifty two have repayment plans while only three hundred four thousand pounds of the five point one million has been recovered so far leaving the taxpayer situation still RAW 🩸 and unresolved!! Veterans are demanding more clarity on how the debt was calculated and some are straight up calling for it all to be wiped clean like a post nut 🥜 clarity moment that never arrives.

Former Conservative defence secretary Penny Mordaunt said while public bodies have a duty to recoup costs if it makes financial sense no such assessment has been made in these cases and there is a compelling case in many instances for the debt to be wiped entirely!! The government insists it has a responsibility to recover the funds but an MoD spokesperson told the BBC they recognise errors may cause uncertainty and they are contacting veterans while providing support for anyone who needs it!! "Where payments have been made in genuine error we have a responsibility to recover taxpayer funds and will always seek to do so in a sensitive and proportionate way" the spokesperson added which sounds like the bureaucratic version of "sorry not sorry but we still gonna edge 🖐️ you on this repayment plan"!! However Penny pointed out no financial sense test was even done before they started sending these terrifying letters that hit vets like an unexpected midnight RAID 🛡️ on their savings account.

Barrie Goodwin the RAF veteran contacted Equiniti six years ago after a higher payment than expected and was told it was because he reached state pension age only to later learn he must repay THIRTY 🖐️ TWO 2️⃣ THOUSAND 💰 one hundred eighty eight pounds or struggle HARD 🏋️!! "I checked was told it was all correct and now have to repay it" he said while already cutting back on luxuries and stopping help for his grandchild's nursery which feels like the ultimate pension PUNISHMENT 🍆 from a clerical error that should never have happened!! Equiniti said it cannot discuss individual cases but recognises the concern caused to pensioners and noted that administration of a scheme this scale involves multiple organisations systems and processes over many years so the blame is spread like a group edging session gone wrong!! Sopra Steria took over the veterans pension scheme in twenty twenty three and said the errors originated over a decade before they arrived yet they are now working with the MoD and Equiniti to put robust safeguards in place so this nightmare doesn't repeat and leave more vets 🪖 down bad 😩 from surprise debt letters that arrive out of the blue like a bad one night stand 💦 with the taxman!! The Forces Pension Society advises anyone receiving an overpayment letter to verify its authenticity request more information and complain through the Internal Disputes Procedure before the financial shock completely cooks them alive at three in the morning when the panic really sets in!!
